## Generating mechanism

The original four binary patterns on a 6 by 6 block layout are expanded to an
`nside` by `nside` lattice. Spatial vectors retain row-major block ordering;
coordinates increase x first and decrease y between rows, as in the supplied
script. The mean is $b+F_{sp}W^T+U_mV^T$. W and V assign one spatial and one
nonspatial loading category per feature before category-specific weighting.
Purely spatial genes have V=0; mixed genes combine spatial and nonspatial
intensities; nonspatial genes have W=0. Slice-specific U contains independent
Bernoulli(0.2) entries. Counts use `rnbinom(size=nb_shape,mu=mu)` with variance
$\mu+\mu^2/\mathrm{nb\_shape}$. No extra dropout is added.

```{r}
library(MSGPCA)
sim <- simulation_gg_blocks(nside=12,seed=101)
names(sim)
dim(sim$Y_list[[1]])
sim$gene_groups
sim$perturbations[c('affected_slices','intensity','mechanism')]
```

Defaults are 50 spatial + 300 mixed + 50 nonspatial = 400 features. The manuscript
reports 500; the source does not specify that alternative composition. Changing
feature counts is supported but does not establish exact manuscript reproduction.

## Scenarios

| Scenario | Mechanism | Default intensity |
|---|---|---:|
| none | Conserved baseline | 0 |
| slab | Replace background counts in y <= 0.3 and x+y <= 0.9 masks | 20 |
| wave | Replace background counts below sinusoidal boundary and x+y <= 0.9 | 8 |
| centroid_shift | Add counts to purely spatial genes in slices 3--5 | 25 |

Wave boundary is $0.5+0.15\sin(4\pi x)+0.04\cos(10\pi x)$.
Replacement groups are disjoint contiguous background feature groups, each by
default 20%, rounded as in the source. Other entries are unchanged. Centroid
shifts leave slices 1--2 unchanged, add wave structure to slice 3, x+y >= 1.2 to
slice 4, and a circle of squared radius 0.08 centered at (0.5,0.5) to slice 5.
Any further slices remain unperturbed. This uses the implemented
`inject_spatial_centroid_shifts()` mechanism; the script's undefined
`inject_heterogeneous_features()` is not recreated from comments.

```{r}
slab <- simulation_gg_blocks(nside=6,scenario='slab',seed=101)
none <- simulation_gg_blocks(nside=6,scenario='none',seed=101)
cohort <- simulation_gg_blocks(nside=6,n_slices=5,
                              scenario='centroid_shift',seed=101)
length(cohort$true_cluster_labels)
```

## Ground truth and evaluation

The simulation retains W, V, U for every slice and baseline patterns, allowing
reconstruction of the generating mean. Exact masks, affected slices, intensities,
feature indices and replacement/additive status identify every local operation.
`true_local_patterns` is zero for unaffected slices. Conserved cluster labels
always identify four original domains plus background, not perturbation masks.
Generating loadings need not be orthogonal, unlike the fitted model.

The reproducible experiment scripts under `experiments/` evaluate arithmetic
entropy NMI, $2I/(H_A+H_B)$, ARI, pooled and mean-slice metrics separately, and
subspace recovery after centering. Both constant partitions have NMI one; one
constant partition against a nonconstant partition has NMI zero. Compare spans
or canonical correlations instead of individual factor columns. Report leakage
of local masks into shared scores alongside local recovery; local and shared
patterns can themselves overlap, so leakage is not a uniquely identifiable
parameter error. Fixed seeds restore the caller RNG state. One call generates
one dataset and never writes files.
